items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: when Natalie Cole -- to me she reminded me very much of Aretha Franklin

ctx.x: It's her, you know. She's not trying to do anybody else. Well, there's one time -- I have to take that back. There was one time I thought very much she sounded -- she was greatly influenced by Aretha Franklin. That was my personal opinion. I very much -- you know, I listened and

said, 'My God.' I couldn't hardly tell, really, that it wasn't Aretha, because Aretha had been so big for so long, you know, and this was all you could hear, and when Natalie Cole -- to me she reminded me very much of Aretha Franklin. I'm not saying that she -- that she was copying her. I'm not saying that, but I'm just saying the style was similar, to me. But I think she has gotten away from that, you know, now.
Yeah, she seems to have. When Nat used to rehearse his big band at your house, who was in that big band, do you remember?
